name: random
doc: Pseudo-random numbers (not for secrets: use crypto.rand).

items.name: Bytes
items.doc: Bytes returns n pseudo-random bytes (use crypto.rand for secrets).
items.summary: Bytes returns n pseudo-random bytes (use crypto.rand for secrets).

items.name: Float
items.doc: Float returns a pseudo-random float in [0, 1).
items.summary: Float returns a pseudo-random float in [0, 1).

items.name: Int
items.doc: Int returns a non-negative pseudo-random int.
items.summary: Int returns a non-negative pseudo-random int.

items.name: IntN
items.doc: IntN returns a pseudo-random int in [0, n).
items.summary: IntN returns a pseudo-random int in [0, n).

items.name: Seed
items.doc: Seed seeds the default pseudo-random generator.
items.summary: Seed seeds the default pseudo-random generator.

items.name: Shuffle
items.doc: Shuffle permutes xs pseudo-randomly in place.
items.summary: Shuffle permutes xs pseudo-randomly in place.
